primary_anchor_zh: 宽阔红色机身和高大的黑色键盘区
story_reason_zh: 打字机被取去清洁，随后回到书桌

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型复古打字机在木墙书房的宽书桌中央，纸张边缘被微风轻轻掀动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 纸张边缘被微风轻轻掀动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 宽阔红色机身和高大的黑色键盘区占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 店员缓慢抱起打字机并从侧门搬出画面；随后呈现空书桌中央和后方木墙。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 店员缓慢抱起打字机并从侧门搬出画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空书桌中央和后方木墙

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 店员缓慢将打字机搬回画面并放回书桌中央
shot_design.main_action_zh: 店员缓慢将打字机搬回画面并放回书桌中央
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新清楚呈现宽阔红色机身和高大的黑色键盘区，物件占据足够画面面积。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed medium shot frames a large red vintage typewriter with a broad black keyboard at the center of a wide desk in a wood-paneled study. The edge of its paper lifts gently. Warm window light gives the typewriter a strong graphic silhouette.

A fixed medium shot shows a large red vintage typewriter with a broad black keyboard at the center of a wide desk in a wood-paneled study. A shopkeeper slowly lifts the typewriter and carries it through a side doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty center of the wide desk and the wood-paneled wall behind it. Light through the blinds shifts softly.

A fixed medium shot holds on the empty center of the wide desk and the wood-paneled wall behind it. A shopkeeper slowly carries the large red vintage typewriter with a broad black keyboard back into frame and places it at the center of a wide desk in a wood-paneled study.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 店员缓慢抱起打字机并从侧门搬出画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空书桌中央和后方木墙
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 店员缓慢将打字机搬回画面并放回书桌中央
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
